optimized_sql:
WITH hd_filtered AS (
    SELECT household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE (household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
           OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND CASE
              WHEN household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 0
              THEN household_demographics.hd_dep_count / household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count
              ELSE null
          END > 1
),
date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT date_dim.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND date_dim.d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2)
),
store_filtered AS (
    SELECT store.s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE store.s_county IN ('Williamson County', 'Williamson County', 'Williamson County', 'Williamson County')
),
sales_hd AS (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_ticket_number,
           store_sales.ss_customer_sk,
           store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk,
           store_sales.ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN hd_filtered
      ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_filtered.hd_demo_sk
),
dj AS (
    SELECT sales_hd.ss_ticket_number,
           sales_hd.ss_customer_sk,
           count(*) cnt
    FROM sales_hd
    JOIN date_dim_filtered
      ON sales_hd.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
    JOIN store_filtered
      ON sales_hd.ss_store_sk = store_filtered.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY sales_hd.ss_ticket_number,
             sales_hd.ss_customer_sk
)
SELECT customer.c_last_name,
       customer.c_first_name,
       customer.c_salutation,
       customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt
FROM dj
JOIN customer
  ON dj.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC,
         customer.c_last_name ASC
